name: Nakiri Alice
source:
Alice is Erina Nakiri's cousin and a first-year student of Totsuki Culinary Academy. She is half-Danish and half-Japanese. Like her cousin, she has a dignified appearance with fair skin and a curved body, though she possesses short, silver hair and a pair of stylized eyes that often deform into cartoonish shapes. Her extremely pale skin, whitish silver hair and red eyes is likely the result of albinism. For most of her childhood, she lived in Erina's shadow; as such, to improve herself, she travelled to Denmark at the age of 5 to improve her culinary skills, hoping to eventually surpass her cousin.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Food_Wars:_Shokugeki_no_Soma_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
